text: Lieutenant Antienne is a Breton member of the Shornhelm City Guard found at Oldgate.
Lieutenant Belron is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is found at their camp in Vernim Woods.
Lieutenant Corvinus is an Imperial officer in charge of the Seventh Legion troops found at the Basking Grounds.
Lieutenant Fairfax is a Breton member of the Shornhelm City Guard. He is currently in charge of fixing the situation at Hinault Farm.
Lieutenant Galyn is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is being held hostage by Covenant forces at the Dagger's Point Invasion Camp.
Lieutenant Gelin is a deceased Bosmer soldier of the Dominion found inside a cave beneath the Temple of the Dark Moon.
Lieutenant Hervarion is an Altmer soldier of the Dominion held prisoner by the crazed residents of Southpoint.
Lieutenant Khari is a Redguard and the leader of the Covenant forces found inside the ruins of Ne Salas.
Lieutenant Koruni is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact found at Fort Morvunskar.
Lieutenant Livisii Alor is a Dunmer soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. She is found at Jorunn's Stand.
Lieutenant Maelys is a Breton soldier of the Covenant found at the Bangkorai Gate.
Lieutenant Sgugh is an Orsimer member of the Shornhelm City Guard. She is currently watching over the refugees at Camp Tamrith.
Lieutenant Shra is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu. She is part of the contingent combatting the Maulborn Cult in the Obsidian Gorge.
Lieutenant Silen is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu. She is investigating the attack on their caravan near the ruins of Mzithumz.
Lieutenant Voteporix is an Imperial officer of the Seventh Legion. He is in charge of the troops camped at the Old Tower.
Lig gra-Murug is an Orsimer member of the Fighters Guild residing at their enclave in the town of Hissmir, Shadowfen.
Lilou is a powerful Reachman leading the forces inside the Mines of Khuras.
Lilou Guidroz is a Breton elite gear vendor of the Covenant selling her wares at the Merchant House at the Southern High Rock Gate.

Linele Skullcarver is a Reachman of the Boneshaper Clan in . She is found at her camp near Shor's Stone with her son Celarion. She is also a member of the Worm Cult and is currently meeting with another cultist, Lolann, which is posing as spy for the Daggerfall Covenant.
Linihar is a Khajiit mage competing in The Sorcerer Division at the Thizzrini Arena.
Listens-to-Water is a deceased Argonian whose body is located in his hut within the city of Stormhold, Shadowfen.
Lithok is a Redguard priest held hostage by Uwafa at Tu'whacca's Throne.
Livia Nasica is an Imperial bard playing at her camp in Dune. She is the great-granddaughter of the Exalted Bard of Dune, Valencia Nasica.
Livius Silanus is an Imperial in who is the leader of The Thorns, a local group of looters found at the Thorn Lodge.
Llaami is a Dunmer mercenary hired by the Ebonheart Pact. She is found in the Warrior's Rest Tavern at the Southern Morrowind Gate.
Limbrender is a troll residing in the Thizzrini Arena and Kuna's Delve in Reaper's March.
Lienenarth is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, in the region of Greenshade.
Lirdilin is a Bosmer found in the city of Orsinium. She is impossible to interact with, but can be seen talking to Norarubel.
Little Ozur is an ogre located at Little Ozur's Camp in the region of Reaper's March.
Little Murimush is a unique echatere found wandering the streets of Orsinium. He is owned by Lug.
Lirielle Ramori is a Dunmer commoner residing inside Nalman's house in Stormhold.
Lithindur is an Altmer member of the Thieves Guild found in the Thieves Den in the Bazaar District of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Linihi is a Khajiit part of the gang found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Anvil. He cannot be interacted with.
Lion is a creature that appears in . Fishbreath, the leader of the Dawnmead Bandits, has a pet lion, called Lord Tawnlii-do.
Lieutenant Yvondir is an Altmer member of the Fist of Thalmor. He is one of the few survivors of the team that went into the Wilding Run to investigate an undead threat.
Lieutenant Minangor is a Bosmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion in who accompanies Gwaering on her mission to Dra'bul during the quest "The Drublog of Dra'bul."
Lieutenant Ergend is a Breton member of the Evermore City Guard.
Lishi is a non-hostile Senche-Tiger who can be found walking around at the Khalama's Caravan in Khenarthi's Roost.
Lieutenant Castorius is an Imperial officer of the Seventh Legion. She is found at their camp east of the Martyr's Crossing.
Limenauruus is a Minotaur boss that appears in . He is found inside Tribune's Folly and serves Lord Nunex Faleria.
Llandras Gathram is a Dunmer artisan found at the docks in Vivec City.
Linlia is a Nord noble located in Skalar's Living Quarters, inside Skalar's Hostel, a tavern in Orsinium.
Littrel Green-Hilt is a Nord found at the Shadowfen Markets in Stormhold.
Littid is a Nord pilgrim in Vivec City on Vvardenfell. He can be found in Saint Delyn Waistworks. He is the owner of Keba.
Lion Guard Elite is a generic Noble residing in several locations in .
Lingarmoril is a Altmer clothier working at a loom in the Tailors and Dyers Hall within the Saint Olms Waistworks in Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Llanas Dalvilu is a Dunmer residing in Woodhearth, Greenshade. He works close to the entrance to the Imperial Underground.
Litaagonir is an Altmer chef found in the kitchen of Kinlady Avinisse's Mansion in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Linwenvar is an Altmer found sitting on a rock west of Shimmerene, Summerset. A dog named Fleabag can be found next to him. Linwenvar may also be found at the Ald Mora Ruins.
Little Pelagius is a Nord who appears in Pelagius the Mad's nightmares during the quest "The Mind of Madness." He is seen during the Night Terrors segment.
Lieutenant Sathis is a Dunmer lieutenant of the Ebonheart Pact stationed in the Imperial City Sewers, inside the Ebonheart Pact base.
Lieutenant Furlarros is an Altmer who can be found in a camp near Sea Keep in Summerset. He cannot be interacted with.

Lirtis Githalvel is a Dunmer siege expert of the Ebonheart Pact located at the Northern Morrowind Gate's siege range. He is knowledgable about siege engines and may offer information about them to the player.
Liodes Catraso is an Imperial residing in Hakoshae, Northern Elsweyr. He appears only at the end of "Descendant of the Potentate" in the crowd of people listening to Magnate Feina-Darak.
Lieutenant Lein-Barduik was an Akaviri who lived sometime in the First Era.
Lion Guard Alchemist is a generic character located in the Lion's Den. They are members of the Lion Guard faction.
Listens-By-Smell is an Argonian residing in Root-Whisper Village, Murkmire.
Lionora Two-Tongue is a Bosmer beggar who can be encountered at various locations across Reaper's March. Helping her counts toward the "Give to the Poor" achievement.
Lirch is a Redguard nobleman in who resides in the court of Castle Sentinel.
Lights-the-Way is an Argonian mystic in Lilmoth located outside of the Guild Hall. She is also author of the books Ku-Vastei: The Needed Change and The Sharper Tongue: A Jel Primer.
Lisrek is a Nord vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .
Lieutenant Vinicius is an Imperial residing in the Enclave of the Hourglass.
Llerar Vinden is a Dunmer commoner who resides in Ald Velothi.
Lledsea Relas is a Dunmer commoner who resides in Ald Velothi.
Llaros Uvayn is a Dunmer living in Caldera. She is a member of House Hlaalu. She acts as a spell merchant.

Llemisa Marys is a Dunmer Thief who resides in Hla Oad, Morrowind. She is a member of the Camonna Tong, and is located in the caverns beneath Fatleg's Drop Off among the slavers and smugglers. Llemisa offers thief-related training and wares.
Llorayna Sethan is a Dunmer living in Tel Branora, Morrowind.

Llevena Sendas is a Dunmer in located in Molag Mar. She is a Buoyant Armigers and a novice member of the Tribunal Temple who resides at the Armigers Stronghold in the city's waistworks. She dons chitin armor and carries steel weapons. Llevena does not provide any services and is not involved in any quests.
Llevana Salaren is a Dunmer Acrobat and a layman member of the Tribunal who resides at the Molag Mar Temple atop the city.
Llevana Nedaren is a Dunmer farmer residing in her home in Cheydinhal. She is involved in the quest "Corruption and Conscience."

Llensi Llaram is a Dunmer member of the Anvil Fighters Guild. As seen in conversations with her and other guild members, she is relatively new to the guild, and is originally from Morrowind, near Khuul.

Lord Drad is a Dunmer who owns an estate north of Anvil, where he lives with his wife, Lady Drad. He uses ogres as slaves in the silver mine to the east of his manor, which he claims will make his fortune. The ogres play a part in the "Malacath's Shrine" quest.
Llerar Mandas is a Dunmer crusader who lives in Ebonheart. He is a Crusader and House Brother of the Great House Redoran. He can be found in the Grand Council Chamber. He wears a set of Dwemer armor.
Llivas Othravel is a Dunmer witchhunter living in Ebonheart.

Lorbumol gro-Aglakh is an Orsimer Smith residing in the Fighters Guild headquarters in Vivec City. He is the initial steward who offers quests for the Vivec Fighters Guild, before receiving them directly from the guildmaster himself. The Nerevarine can purchase materials from him, and he is also able to repair items.
Lod is a Nord who lives in Falkreath and he serves as the town blacksmith. He was once Dengeir of Stuhn's personal guard and values loyalty above all else.
Lokir, or Lokir of Rorikstead, is a Nord horse thief in who was residing in the village of Rorikstead.
Lob is an Orsimer blacksmith who can be found living in the Orcish Stronghold of Largashbur.
Lodvar is a Nord lumberjack. He resides in Dragon Bridge, and lives in his brother's house with Horgeir and Olda.

Llathasa Indarys was a Dunmer countess and is the deceased wife of Count Andel Indarys. Her husband, Andel Indarys, as well as her only son, Farwil Indarys, survived her. Several flowers sit in her empty throne in Castle Cheydinhal. She died from an apparent trip on the stairs, but rumors suggest several different causes, including murder.
Logvaar is a Nord residing in Bruma. He is not involved in any training or quests. Logvaar works at the Jerall View Inn.

Lloros Sarano is a Dunmer priest who can be found at the Ald'ruhn Temple. He sells potions, ingredients, books and spells from the Conjuration, Destruction, Mysticism and Restoration schools of magic.

Lliryn Fendyn is a Dunmer Thief, and resides in Rethan Manor. He is a member of House Hlaalu, and offers training to the Nerevarine. He also sells thieving tools. If the Nerevarine is a member of one the other great houses, he will attack them on sight.

Lord Cluttermonkey is an Argonian who can be found via console commands in the test cell "Clutter Warehouse - Everything Must Go!." He possesses a full set of Daedric armor and carries Clutterbane, a unique magical weapon. Lord Cluttermonkey is hostile and will attack on sight. The only way to purchase something from him is to sneak up on him and cast a Calm spell. He is designated to buy and sell probes and lockpicks from the player, but since he possesses none of those, nor has money to buy them, it is somewhat useless to barter with him.
Llavesa Drom is a Dunmer Master-at-Arms, and a member of the Camonna Tong who resides in Vivec City.
Llerusa Hlaalu is a Dunmer Noble and a member of House Hlaalu. She can be found in the Ascadian Isles region of Morrowind.
Llavane Hlas is a Dunmer archer living in Ald'ruhn. She is a guard employed by Redoran Councillor Miner Arobar to watch the bedrooms of his manor.
Llevas Fels is a Dunmer Savant, and Camonna Tong thug living in Sadrith Mora.
Llarusea Andrethi is a Dunmer sorcerer who resides in Aharnabi.
Llathyno Hlaalu is a Dunmer priest who resides in the Temple in Balmora. She sells books, ingredients, and potions as well as spells and spellmaking services.
Llavam Adas is a Dunmer bandit, and resides in the cave of Punammu.
Llaynasa Othran is a Dunmer smuggler who resides on the Gro-Bagrat Plantation. She is a member of the Camonna Tong, where she has the rank of Brute.
Lleran Andoril is a Dunmer rogue and a member of a bandit gang that has occupied the Dunmer stronghold Andasreth. He can be found on the upper level and is hostile.
Lleras Andalen is a Dunmer Miner who resides in Elith-Pal Mine.

Llirala Sendas is a Dunmer who resides in Morrowind. She lives on an island in the Sheogorad region. She is a Monk and Initiate of the Temple, and the current caretaker of the Sanctus Shrine. She lives in a small shack, Llirala's Shack, next to the shrine. The island is southeast of Vas.
Llonas Felder is a Dunmer priest who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton.
Llondryn Hlaalo is a Dunmer who resides in Nissintu. He will attack Nerevarine on sight.
Llovyn Andus is a Dunmer who resides in Morrowind. He owns a farm in the Ascadian Isles. He also has a tame guar on his property.
Llunela Hleran is a Dunmer member of House Telvanni who resides at the Telvanni Council House in Sadrith Mora.
Lokil is a Nord vampire encountered inside Dimhollow Crypt‎. He is in charge of a Volkihar small search party looking for a mysterious vampire artifact.
Llewellyn the Nightingale is a bard who can be hired to stay in Lakeview Manor.
Lleril Morvayn is a Dunmer who resides in Raven Rock as First Councilor and represents House Redoran.

Lord Arcady Noellaume is a Breton noble in held hostage with his wife and other members of the family, by the Red Rook Bandits in their house outside Daggerfall, Glenumbra. After the Vestige has rescued him and his companions he plans to go on a hunting trip as he thinks the ordeal they went through was a great adventure.

Lokra is an Orsimer in Stonetooth Fortress. She is the chief's daughter but instead of waiting to be wed to another clan, she wants to be an adventurer, sail and see the world before she gets married. If she was persuaded to leave, she can later be found in other cities of the Daggerfall Covenant.
Lord Alain Diel is a Breton lord in found at his camp in the Shrieking Scar, Glenumbra north of Daggerfall. He is investigating the harpy attacks nearby.
Loic Dutheil is a Breton who resides in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be found drinking at The Rosy Lion inn.
Lob the Cleaver is an Orsimer residing in Cradlecrush. He is the author of Mammoth Duty.
Logru is an Orsimer chef residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. She works at the Sleepy Sailor Inn, where she sells various food items.
Long-Claw is an Argonian located in Xal Ithix, Shadowfen. She is likely the first character the Vestige will encounter upon entering Xal Ithix.

Lord Gharesh-ri is a Khajiit and the Speaker of the Mane, Akkhuz-ri. They are both long-time friends. His duties consist of traveling to places incorporated into the Aldmeri Dominion to speak on the Mane's behalf when he is too busy with other matters.
Lodiss the Rock is a Nord member of the Undaunted. He is found with his companions at the Undaunted Enclave in Wayrest. The Vestige can buy him a drink as part of This One's On Me achievement.
Long-Cast is an Argonian refugee residing in The Gray Mire in the region of Grahtwood.
Llurour Dres is a Dunmer grocer. He sells his wares at his stall, Comestibulary, in the Royal Bazaar of Mournhold.

Logrolf was the High King of Skyrim during part of the early Second Era. He died around the time of the death of Akaviri Potentate Versidue Shaie, and the subsequent fall of the Reman Empire, in 2E 430 or 431. He had one known daughter, Freydis.
Llewydr is a character in . She can be found in Snowline, and buys and sells spells. If the Hero asks her to send them back to Snowline, she will leave them outside of Rilora's house.
Lluther Serethran is a Dunmer and the innkeeper of the Brooding Elf Inn in Quarantine Serk.
Llenus Renimus is a Dunmer afflicted with the Llodos Plague. He is found in the camp for those affected inside the catacombs underneath Quarantine Serk.
Llarol Andavel is a Dunmer found at the docks of Shad Astula. He has no unique dialogue.
Longald is a Nord student found inside the dormitory of Shad Astula.
Llotha Nelvani is a Dunmer found in the graveyard of Evermore. She is trying to solve a tightly-locked box that was left there by previous members of her former group.
Lolethys Llandu is a Dunmer part of the outlaws gang found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Marbruk.
Lodorr is an ancient Draugr who was entombed within the Hall of the Dead of Windhelm during the Merethic Era.
Logorunn Darkmoon is a Nord stablemaster of the Ebonheart Pact. He operates the stables at the Northern Morrowind Gate.
Logangar Darkstorm is a Nord patron of the Cold Moon Inn in Windhelm.
Lliae the Quick is an Altmer and only surviving member of the Quickstep Bandits residing in the town of Chorrol.
Lleram is a Kothringi spirit found within Zuuk, where he is being interrogated by Aldmeri Dominion forces.
Lodyna Arethi is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is found in the ruins of Zuuk.
Lludyn Hlandu is a Dunmer residing in the city of Mournhold.
Llether Nilem is a Dunmer guild trader. He operates his kiosk at the Lake Honrich Holdings in Riften.
Lorchon is a Bosmer found near the Battle of Cormount Memorial. He and his brother are the founders of a Bosmer group opposed to the Aldmeri Dominion known as the second Blacksap Rebellion.
Lohupeel is an Argonian residing in Sanguine's Demesne, in the region of Shadowfen.
Lord Ellic Dorell is a Breton residing in the city of Northpoint. He is the son of Baron Alard Dorell.
Logrun is an Orsimer residing in the Thizzrini Arena, Reaper's March.
Longstig is a Nord patron of the Silver Moons Inn at the Baandari Trading Post.
Looks-Under-Rocks is an Argonian researcher trying to retrieve a powerful relic from the Sunscale Strand. He is searching for his ancestors' artifacts.
Llorayna Ash-Hands is a Dunmer residing at the outlaws refuge in the city of Orsinium.
Lockjaw is a named skeever who may be found in Geirmund's Hall, in the region of The Rift.
Llavana Merobar is a Dunmer hunter residing in Quarantine Serk.
Llavesa Omani is a character residing in Fort Virak, Stonefalls.
Lleveas Heran is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact found in Davon's Watch. He can be seen celebrating upon the Vestige's completion of "City Under Siege."
Llivia Ralas is a Dunmer clothier and a member of the Ebonheart Pact. She sells her wares at the Merchant House at the Northern Morrowind Gate.
Lonel Begnaud is a Breton laborer found sweeping the floors on the lower deck of the Prowler in Anvil, The Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.
Looks-too-Long is an Argonian alchemist residing in the city of Stormhold, Shadowfen.
Lobelathel is an insane Bosmer living alone in her home, Sweetbreeze Cottage.
Loncano is an Altmer archivist found in the Arboretum of the Imperial City. He is trying to preserve as many Imperial documents as he can amidst the Daedric occupation of the city.
Lorais is an Altmer bard performing onstage in The Mercantile, the marketplace of Skywatch. She has no unique dialogue.
Looks-Forward is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at the Northern Morrowind Gate.
Lorant Marigny is a Breton found south of Stonechewer Goblin Camp.
Lord Ethian is a Breton and the husband of Lady Sovelle, an ambassador from Daggerfall. He is accompanying her on her diplomatic mission to Orsinium.
Llavelea Omani is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed in Fort Virak.
Llondryn Dals is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed in Fort Virak.
Llunela is a Dunmer prostitute working at The Ebony Flask in Ebonheart.
Load Dummy is an unused Vampire Lord in . It was most likely used as a testing character to test Vampire Lord attributes. It will never be hostile unless attacked.
Lob gro-Murgob is a deceased male character in the New Sheoth Graveyard. He is one of eight other inhabitants of the Shivering Isles already buried at the arrival of the Hero of Kvatch on the isles.
Llivas Driler is a Dunmer Battlegrounds Furnisher working at Battlegrounds Housing Goods in the Gladiator's Quarters of Vivec City.
Lodiss is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at their camp at the base of Trolhetta.
Logangar Brittleblade is a Nord warrior found dead at Darkwater Crossing.
Llero Benethran is a character residing in Ald'ruhn, in Vvardenfell.
Looter Bully is a character residing in Vivec City, in Vvardenfell.
Looter Cutthroat is a character residing in Vivec City, in Vvardenfell.
Llayne Sadri is a Dunmer residing in Tel Mora, in Vvardenfell. As Mistress Dratha's mouth, she also appears in Sadrith Mora during the relevant scenes with the Mouths.
Lorcette, also known as Goblin, is a child that appears in . She lived in Mountain Watch until the village was evacuated during the Umbriel Crisis.
Lokkestiiz (Dragon Language: ) is a dragon in . He serves under the "avatar of Alkosh," Nahviintaas.

Lord Bowyn of Wayrest was a Breton nobleman who held claim over an area of the Wrothgarian Mountains during the Third Era. In 3E 399, the Orsimer hero Gortwog gro-Nagorm acquired the entirety of the land by defeating Lord Bowyn in a duel. The Third Orsinium was built on a mountainside shortly after.
Lojaku is a Khajiit residing at the Foyada Quarry. He has no unique dialogue.
Lord Bacaro Volorus, also known as The Ascendant Lord and The Ascendant Lord Bacaro, is a Breton located in High Isle and Amenos and Galen and Y'ffelon in and .
Llavelea Indarys is a Dunmer residing in Holamayan Monastery in Vvardenfell.

Lucien Lachance is a Speaker of the Black Hand, the core of the Dark Brotherhood, in . He is the very first contact and recruiter for the Hero of Kvatch into the Dark Brotherhood. For much of the duration of the Dark Brotherhood questline, he is the Speaker overseeing the Hero. His only formal residence is Fort Farragut, which is located east of Cheydinhal.

Lorkhan, also known as Doom Drum, is the elven name for the Missing God, the deity most directly associated with the existence of Mundus, and is the god of all mortals. According to legend, Lorkhan died long ago, giving his life for convincing the Aedra to create Mundus. His divine spark fell to Nirn as a shooting star "to impregnate it with the measure of its existence and a reasonable amount of selfishness." Lorkhan's heart was indirectly responsible for at least three major near-disasters in the last decades of the Third Era, and his remains are connected to the disappearance of the Dwemer. It is also believed by some that Nirn's moons, Masser and Secunda, are the two halves of Lorkhan's

Lord Woodborne is a noble who resides in Wayrest. He was betrothed to Princess Elysana, but during the chaotic Battle of Cryngaine Field, he assassinated King Lysandus of Daggerfall. Allegedly, he had a connection to Gothryd, the son of Lysandus himself. Lysandus does not rest. His spirit sought vengeance. He haunted the streets of Daggerfall and shouted "Vengeance...." Lord Woodborne met his end at the hands of the mysterious agent of Uriel Septim VII.
Lord Lovidicus is an Imperial vampire who resides in Crowhaven, which is north of Anvil. He is the father of Agronak gro-Malog, who now lives in the Imperial City Arena.

Lum gro-Baroth is a Journeyman level Block trainer found at the Fighters Guild in Chorrol. Kurz gro-Baroth is his brother, also at the same guildhall. He sleeps in an allowed space in the Chorrol Fighters Guild basement. He practices archery outside immediately after waking up, and spends a sparring session against Sabine Laul near her forge in the basement.
Lord Kelvyn was a Redguard Knight of the True Horn and Lord of Battlehorn Castle before he was killed by a group of marauders as they held his castle under siege.
Lorkmir was a Nord who lived in the Elven Gardens District of the Imperial City. He has been murdered in his basement recently. His house has become Faelian's personal skooma den.
Lucan Valerius is an Imperial in who lives in Riverwood and runs the Riverwood Trader with his sister, Camilla Valerius.
Lucan Ostorius is an Imperial Thief who lives by a road in the West Gash in Morrowind. He is a member of the Thieves Guild.
Lucretinaus Olcinius is an Imperial trader who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton. He is the father of Cassius Olcinius.
Lorod is a Nord Barbarian, and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. He is located on the bottom level of the stronghold's keep.
Lucilla Corrium is a character mentioned in . She was the sister of Calixto Corrium, and helped create Calixto's House of Curiosities with her brother.

Lucky Lorenz is a deceased Nord hunter whose body is located in his shack, an unmarked location across the river west of the Abandoned Prison. He can sometimes be found floating in the water underneath the stairs in the front of the crushed house.
Lord Vhokken , also known as Mount Vhokken, was a warlord and lifelong loyal servant of Wolf-Queen Potema in Solitude in early Third Era.

Lord Thone was a trusted war-chief of King Mantiarco. He is best known for having a secret affair with the first wife of Mantiarco, Queen Amodetha of Solitude. As a result, he and the queen had a son, Prince Bathorgh, who was considered a son of the King himself. However, in 3E 97, during an investigation due to rumors of Thone's treason, Mantiarco found out about the affair. He henceforth banished Prince Bathorgh from Skyrim, and Thone's post was taken by a loyal servant of Queen Potema, Lord Vhokken. The further fate of Lord Thone is uncertain, as he is not mentioned in any other records.
Lortheim is a priest of Talos who can be found in the Temple of Talos in Windhelm. He serves Talos there along with his wife, Jora.

Lucky is a named goat in . He is the pet of the child Clinton Lylvieve, in the village of Dragon Bridge. Lucky will often be seen walking around the village with his owner during the day. At night, he is typically found in the basement of the Lylvieve Family's House.
Louis Beauchamp is a Breton mage usually located outside of the Mages Guild in Ald'ruhn, even though he is not a member of the Mages Guild.
Lucia is an Imperial child found sitting on a bench in Whiterun near the Gildergreen tree. As she is an orphan, she can be adopted.

Lord Vanech was an Imperial who both owned and ran his own building commission, Lord Vanech's Building Commission. He worked out of the Imperial City during the Third Era. Due to his efforts, this organization was able to rival the Atrius Building Commission.
Lord Naarifin was an Altmer general who commanded an Aldmeri army of the Third Aldmeri Dominion during the Great War.
Lugdum gro-Lagdub is an Orsimer barbarian residing in Minabi.

Lugnikh is an Orsimer ghost found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed and the ghosts have returned to the temple. He talks about how he is still alive and that the Vestige is the one who is actually dead.
Loremaster Dhalana is a Breton member of the Mages Guild found in their camp in Glenumbra Moors, Glenumbra, in .
Lugbur is an Orsimer member of the Seamount Clan residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. He walks around the dead bodies near the docks.
Lucas is a Breton member of the Fighters Guild. He is the armsman for their branch in Daggerfall.
Lucas Oscent is a Breton from Koeglin Village. He was kidnapped by the Ember-Eye Slavers. His mother Margot is seeking help in retrieving him.
Luceline is a Breton residing in Bad Man's Hallows, Glenumbra. She is found in one of the large tents.
Lugharz is an Orsimer who resided on the Nurin Farm north of Koeglin Village. She has just been dismissed by Mrs. Nurin but she is distraught and asks the Vestige for help.
Loupel Menant is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. He has a stall just inside the north gate of the city, North Gate Novelties, where he sells his wares.
Louis Ervine is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. He is found on a bench, resting in his own way.

Loryvn Daveleth is a Dunmer residing in Davon's Watch. He can be found under the bridge, begging on the street alongside his wife, Melila. They lost their home and baby daughter in the midst of the Daggerfall Covenant bombardment of the city and are now homeless and penniless.
Louic Chrinitte is a Breton carpenter and proprietor of Chrinitte's Carpentry Corner in the city of Evermore.
Lorregil is a Bosmer beggar residing in the port city of Mistral, Khenarthi's Roost.
Lorfolas is a Bosmer stablemaster residing in the Western Elsweyr Gate in Cyrodiil.
Lugolg gro-Goldog is an Orsimer blacksmith and member of the Mages Guild residing on the island of Eyevea. He can be found at Eyevea's Bright Smithy, selling his wares.

Lothson Cold-Eye is a Nord first found with his wife, Marien Erelle, at their camp west of Northpoint. He is a brother to Addald Cold-Eye. Once their related quest is completed, they relocate to Shornhelm.
Lucete Fevre is a Breton woodworker working at The Fighting Edge in the city of Shornhelm.
Loriel is a Breton patron of the Sisters of the Sands Inn in the city of Sentinel, Alik'r Desert.
Lugzod is a character residing in the town of Hoarfrost Downs.
Luglorash is an Orsimer residing in the Wayside Inn in the town of Wind Keep, Stormhaven.
Lord Ruffinari is a dog in Skywatch who can be seen following a Dominion Guard on patrol.
Lorpat-Xeed is an Argonian residing in the city of Davon's Watch.
Lucretia Fortunatus is an Imperial member of the Mages Guild. She is found in Longhaven, where she is looking for missing for a guild expedition that got lost in the Shademist Moors.
Lug is an Orsimer traveling merchant found trading in and around the city of Orsinium. Lug is the owner of his own pack [Echatere|echatere]], Little Murimush.
Lord Trystan is a male Breton who was a close friend of Gaiden Shinji and led the Knights of the Dragon during the First Era. He is the mentor of Commander Reliana, another Knight of the Dragon.
Lorela is a Nord stablemaster who runs Davon's Fine Steeds in Davon's Watch.
Lord Velian is a Reachman member of the Bloodthorn Cult found in his own Plane of Oblivion.
Lucas Errard is a Breton found in the outlaws refuge beneath Anvil. He cannot be interacted with.
Lucky Gurg is an Orsimer found at the docks in Anvil, The Gold Coast. He can be seen playing dice with Ubra and Knuckle-Bones. He is a lackey of Dockmaster Qamar.

Lord Quintus Jarol, or simply Lord Jarol, is an Imperial noble and owner of the Jarol Estate. He is the first assassination target given to the Vestige by Speaker Terenus, as murdering him will prove their devotion to the Dark Brotherhood.
Lucina Faleria was the daughter of Lord Nunex Faleria and Lady Faleria.
Lowtail is a Khajiit residing in Mistral, Khenarthi's Roost. He can be found fishing on the bridge to the edge of town. He has no unique dialogue.
Lorimil is an Altmer encountered during the vision that takes place on Silatar. Lorimil is the husband of Indrathel, and father of Aranias.
Lorwen is a Bosmer archeologist from Rawl'kha. She is found wounded at her campsite northwest of Deathsong Cleft.
Lowindor is a Bosmer member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Marbruk.
Lord Loic Sette is a Breton noble partaking in the party taking place at the At-Tura Estate.
Lort the Gravedigger is a Breton and the gravekeeper of Pelin Graveyard.
Lucette Barbe is a Breton member of the Shornhelm City Guard. She is found in Camp Tamrith.
Lucie Dercirent is a Breton residing inside Milgangor's house in the Redfur Trading Post.
Lucienne Mavine is a Breton leatherworker. She sells her wares at her stall at the Sentinel Bazaar in Sentinel.
Lucille Coravel is a Breton merchant. She sells her wares in the Sunken Road, near the southwestern entrance.
Lucynda Tanier is a Breton residing in Helena's Home in Koeglin Village. She can be found standing by the cooking fire. She has no unique dialogue.
Lumagne Malarelie is a Breton and a member of the Wind Keep Town Guard.
Lorelia is a powerful Nereid residing in the ruins of Bisnensel.
Lucia Portius is an Imperial mystic residing in Fort Amol. She sells her wares at her stall, Curios & Crystals, at the Merchant Caravans.
Lucinia Rose is an Imperial residing at The Withered Rose, her mother Ladia's establishment. While the mother serves as a barkeep for the patrons, Lucinia tends to the crops and livestock kept there.
Lucius is an Imperial working as a courier on behalf of the Weynon Priory. While on an assignment, he got trapped within Coldcorn Ruin.
Lothakar Secret-Oath is a Nord found in his camp outside of Belkarth with his horse, dog and crow.
Lothafi is a Nord member of the Ternion Monks found in Mistwatch.
Lugdugul is an Orsimer banker working at the Bank of Abah's Landing, residing in that city.
Lord Thanlen is a Dunmer residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. He can initially be found at Gnisis or the Urshilaku Camp.
Lum gro-Buzbee is an Orsimer residing in Kireth Vanos' camp north of Grudge-Rock Falls.

Luc is a hairless, monkey-like Daedra. He had long arms and legs, and his fingers were extraordinarily long, thin, and delicate. His mouth, was both huge and toothless. He was one of the many Daedra hobs working in Qijne's kitchen. When Annaïg joined the kitchen, he helped her bringing the ingredients she required. It was Annaïg who named him, since he resembled her cousin Luc when he was a child. He was most likely dead after chef Toel invaded Qijne's kitchen as Annaïg and Slyr were the only known survivors.
Lugbagg is an Orsimer born of the Shatul Clan residing in Shatul Range, Wrothgar.
Lord Rhel was Lord Umbriel's steward. He was the second most powerful lord in Umbriel. He lives in Rhel Palace, the greatest of the eight palaces in Umbriel.
Lord Irrel was one of the lords living in Umbriel. He sponsored Chef Toel's kitchen.
Lord Thenley is an Altmer patron of the Anchors Aweigh Inn in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He is Earl Leythen in disguise.
Lugurzog is an Orsimer residing in the northwestern corner of the city of Shimmerene, Summerset, where she can be found playing a game with Baronas, Faldaleb, and Sorr. She has no unique dialogue.
Loremaster Celarus is an Altmer who can be found in the Ceporah Tower in Artaeum.
Ludippe Guegan is a deceased Breton member of the Undaunted found in the Hall of the Warrior of Hel Ra Citadel, still clinging to life before dying.

Loxaldesh is an Argonian fisherman of the Bright-Throat Tribe found on the docks of the Bright-Throat Village. She used to ferry people about in her raft until a close call with a Haj Mota destroyed it. She now hunts bog-eels when they are in season.
Lucia Livianus is an Imperial residing in the Solitude Fighters Guild in Solitude.
